elements.requirement: Where a teacher in a foundation, voluntary aided, or foundation special school is dismissed by the school's governing body pursuant to a local authority requirement under paragraph 7 of Schedule 2 to the Education Act 2002, Part X of the Employment Rights Act 1996 takes effect as if the local authority had at all material times been the teacher's employer.
elements.quote: the local authority had at all material times been the teacher’s employer

elements.requirement: Where a teacher in a foundation, voluntary aided, or foundation special school is dismissed by the school's governing body pursuant to a local authority requirement under paragraph 7 of Schedule 2 to the Education Act 2002, Part X of the Employment Rights Act 1996 takes effect as if the local authority had dismissed the teacher.
elements.quote: the local authority had dismissed him

elements.requirement: Where a teacher in a foundation, voluntary aided, or foundation special school is dismissed by the school's governing body pursuant to a local authority requirement under paragraph 7 of Schedule 2 to the Education Act 2002, Part X of the Employment Rights Act 1996 takes effect as if the reason or principal reason for the dismissal was the reason or principal reason for which the local authority required the dismissal.
elements.quote: the reason or principal reason for which they did so had been the reason or principal reason for which they required his dismissal

elements.requirement: For the purposes of a complaint under section 111 of the Employment Rights Act 1996 arising from such a dismissal, section 117(4)(a) applies as if the words 'not practicable for the local education authority to permit compliance' were substituted for 'not practicable to comply'.
elements.quote: section 117(4)(a) applies as if for the words “not practicable to comply” there were substituted the words “ not practicable for the local education authority to permit compliance ”

elements.requirement: For the purposes of a complaint under section 111 of the Employment Rights Act 1996 arising from such a dismissal, section 123(5) applies as if references to the employer were to the local authority.
elements.quote: section 123(5) applies as if the references in it to the employer were to the local authority

elements.requirement: In section 134 of the Employment Rights Act 1996, the term 'local authority' has the meaning given by section 579(1) of the Education Act 1996.
elements.quote: “ local authority ” has the meaning given by section 579(1) of the Education Act 1996
